suppress.notes: androidx.sqlite is a Java/Kotlin wrapper around the platform's SQLite (android.database.sqlite); it ships no SQLite of its own (no androidx.sqlite:sqlite-bundled). Its version 2.6.x is taken for the C library "SQLite 2.6", so every SQLite CVE matches. Native SQLite on the head unit is the OS's (the OEM's updates).
The Jellyfin SDK (client library) is taken for the Jellyfin media server. All matched CVEs are in server endpoints (ffmpeg arguments, subtitle upload, LiveTV, SyncPlay, /users …), not in the SDK.
kotlin-logging (group io.github.oshai) is taken for GitHub Enterprise (CVE-2012-2055) because of "github" in the group ID.
